content: Phawuloosi Roome Bis
Nuuni markaben Xaale baanaw qachida wode Awugisxoosa wotaadareta geeteteysatape issi Yuuliyoosa geetetiya mato halaqaas Phawuloosanne hara guutha qasho asata aathidi iyaw immidosona.
Iise gaxan de7iya biittata biya Adramixiyoone markaben gelidi dendida. Maqedoone asi gidida Teselonqe Arsxirokoosi nuura de7ees.
Wontetha gallas nuuni Sidoona gakishin, Yuuliyoosi Phawuloosas keehidi ba laggetako bidi koshshiyaban maaddana mela entako iya yeddis.
Yaape dendidi sinthara nu bolla carkiya gisho haathan teqetida biitta, Qophiroosan zempidi aadhida.
Kilqiyanne Phinfile matan de7iya abba pinnidi Liiqen de7iya Mura gakida.
Yan mato halaqay Xaale biya Iskindire markabe demmidi, iyan nuna gelsis.
Nuuni daro gallas loddara bidi, daro meton Qandoosa katama mati gakida. Yaara baanaw nuna carkoy diggin Salmonara aadhidi haathan teqetida biitta, Qarxeesan zempidi aadhida.
Daro meton gaxa gaxa oykidi Laasa katamaa matan de7iya abba doonan “Markabey Wopu Gidi Shempiya bessi” geetetiya bessa gakida.
Nuuni yan daro wode gam7idaape guye xoomi biletida gisho hizape markaben buussi metiya gisho Phawuloosi enta zoris.
“Asaw, nu buussan gita boshinne daro qohoy de7eysi taw bentees; qohoy caana bollanne markabiya bolla xalaala gidonashin nu de7uwa bollaka gakana” yaagis.
Shin mato halaqay Phawuloosi gidaysafe aathidi markabiya laaggeysinne markabiya goday geysan ammanis.

He abba doonan de7iya katamay balgo ageena aathanaw entaw injetonna gisho, dariya asati bantaw danda7etiko Finqe katamaa gakidi balgo ageena yan aathanaw zoretidosona. Finqey pudeha-wulohapenne dugeha-wulohape giddon abba doonan de7iya katama.
Abba Bolla Gotey Dendis
Kawusha dugeha carkoy loddara carkida wode banta qopidaysada hanidaba entaw daanin dendidi, markabey qaaxonna mela oykiya birata pude ekidi Qarxeesa matara aadhidosona.
Shin daro gam7onna “Awuraqis” geetetiya wolqaama gotey haathan teqetida biittafe duge enta bolla dendis.
He gotey markabiya sugidi efonna diggida gisho carkoy markabiya ba dosida soo efis.
Nuuni yuushoy abban teqetida biitta, Qeedan zempidi bishe daro metootetidi markabiya wogoluwa ashshanaw danda7ida.

Enti wogoluwa pude kessidaape guye wodoruwan markabiya bolla xaaxidi, minthi qachidosona. Surtisa geetetiya shafiyan bantana dom7ethana gidi hirgidi, markabiya sharaa wodhisidi markabiya coo yeddi aggidosona.
Gotey wolqaamishe bin wontetha gallas caanaape baggaa abban holo oykidosona.
Heedzantho gallas markabiya miishiya ekidi banta kushen holidosona.
Nuuni daro gallas awa ayfenne xoolinto be7onna gishonne wolqaama uushoy nu bolla uushida gisho sinthafe nuuni shempora attana gidi qopibooko.
He wode enti daro gallas kathi moonna gam7ida gisho Phawuloosi enta giddon dendi eqidi, “Asaw, hinte ta zoriya ekidi Qarxeesape dendonna aggidako ha metoynne qohoy nuna gakenna.
Shin taani hintena yayyofite gada zorayis; ayis giiko, ha markabey dhayanape attishin, hintefe issi asa shempoyka dhayenna.
Zine qamma ta iyabaa gididaysinne ta goyinniya Xoossay kiitida kiitanchoy ta matan eqidi,
‘Phawuloosa, yayyofa; neeni Roome biitta Kawa Qeesare sinthan eqanaw bessees. Heko Xoossay ne gisho neera biya asa ubbaa shempuwa ashshis’ yaagis.
Hessa gisho, asaw, yayyofite. He kiitanchoy taw odidaysi hananaysa taani ammanayis.
Shin carkoy nuna efidi issi yuushoy abban teqetida biitta gaxan holana” yaagis.
Markabey Meqis
Tammanne oyddantho qamman Adire Abban nuna carkoy gedenne haa sugishin, gidi bilahe gidiya wode markabiyan ootheysatas biittako matidaba daanis.
Enti ciimmotetha eranaw koyidi wodoro xeeran deexiyaba qachidi abban yeggin, abbay hospun tammu wadha gidis. Guuthi gam7idi, zaari yeggin usupun tammu wadha gidis.
Enti abba gaxan de7iya shuchan dom7etona mela yayyidi, markabey boonna mela oykiya oyddu biratata markabiyape guyera abban yeggidi, sa7i wontana mela Xoossaa woossosona.
Markabiyan ootheysati markabiyape baqatanaw koyidi, markabey boonna mela oykiya biratata markabiyape sintha baggara abban yeggiya daanin wogoluwa abban yeggidosona.
Phawuloosi mato halaqaakonne wotaadaretako, “Haysati markabiyan shempi uttonna ixiko hinte attanaw danda7eketa” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, wotaadareti wogoloy qashetida wodoruwa qanxidi yeddi aggidosona.
Sa7ay wontana hanishin ubbay kathi maana mela Phawuloosi asaako, “Hinte kathi moonna naagishe hachira tammanne oyddu gallas gam7ideta.
Hessa gisho, guutha kathi hinte maana mela taani hintena woossayis. Hinte gashtisana mela guutha kathi maanaw koshshees; hari attoshin hinte huuphe binaanape issoyka dhayenna” yaagis.
Phawuloosi hessa gidi uythi ekidi ubbaa sinthan Xoossaa galatis; uythaa menthidi muussu doomis.
Ubbay minetidi bantaw kathi ekidi midosona.
Nuuni markabiyan de7eysati nam7u xeetanne laapun tammanne usupuna.
Enti midi kallida wode caana gistiya abban yeggidi markabiya deexuwa kawushidosona.
Sa7ay wontida wode markabiya oosanchoti aw biitta gakidaako eronnashin, abba gaxan de7iya shafenne silimo be7idosona. Bantaw danda7etiko markabiya he shafiyako shiishanaw qopidosona.

Yaatidi, markabey boonna mela oykiya biratata birshidi abban yeggidosona. He wode laagiya mithaa qachiya wodoruwa birshidosona. Hessafe guye, carkoy markabiya sinthe sugana mela markabiya efiya sharaa sintha baggara dhoqu oothidi buussu doomidosona.
Shin markabey shafe dooren dom7etidi mitetis. Markabiyas sintha baggay xuggunidi shafiya caddi oykidi qaaxonna ixin, guye baggay zuliya sugethan meqeretethi oykis.
Wotaaddareti qasho asaape issoyka haatha wadhidi kessi ekonna mela enta wodhanaw zoretidosona.
Shin mato halaqay Phawuloosa ashshanaw koyidi wotaadareta zoreta ixis. Haathe wadho eriya ubbay markabiyape haathan gupi gupi wodhidi kasetidi gaxa keyana mela kiittis.
Attidaysati sanqa bollanne, markabiya me7uwa bolla keyana mela kiittis. Hessada hanidi ubbay gaxa sarora keyidosona.
